# PiT

**Category:** ViT · **Code:**
[`timm/models/pit.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/pit.py) ·
**Architectures:** 8 · **Pretrained weights:** 8 (8 with ImageNet-1k results)

Pooling-based Vision Transformers (PiT) reduce the spatial size and increase the channels of the tokens between stages
with a depthwise convolution pooling layer, as in CNNs.

## Papers

* [Rethinking Spatial Dimensions of Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.16302)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('pit_s_distilled_224.in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

## Model API support

| Feature | `PoolingVisionTransformer` |
|---|---|
| [`features_only=True` feature maps](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ (strides 7, 14, 28) |
| [`forward_intermediates()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ |
| [`prune_intermediate_layers()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ |
| [Any input size, no changes needed](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`set_input_size()`](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`dynamic_img_size=True`](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`set_grad_checkpointing()`](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✗ |
| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✗ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`PoolingVisionTransformer` with `pit_ti_224` at
224), other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for
details.
